severity, affected asset/tenant counts, KEV and exploitable finding counts, patchable root
cause count, and a lifecycle series, across the authorized partner's tenant scope.

**Notes:**
- `tenant_ids` (optional, comma-separated) restricts the snapshot to specific tenants; omit
  it to include every tenant the caller is authorized for.

  outside that scope returns 403.

parameters.name: tenant_ids

get.summary: Get endpoint usage history for authorized partner tenants.
get.description:
This endpoint returns endpoint usage history, bucketed by day or month, over a bounded date
range for the authorized partner's tenant scope.

**Notes:**
- `tenant_ids` (optional, comma-separated) restricts results to specific tenants.
- `from` / `to` (required, `yyyy-MM-dd`) bound the usage date range. `from` must not be
  later than `to`.
- `grain` (optional, one of `day`, `month`; default `day`) controls the bucketing interval.


Required headers:

- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` (requires the `pulse.read` scope)

parameters.name: tenant_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated tenant ids to read. Every id must be inside the caller's authorized scope, otherwise 403 `tenant_out_of_scope`. Omit it to read every authorized tenant.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Required. First day of the range, `yyyy-MM-dd`. Must not be later than `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Required. Last day of the range, `yyyy-MM-dd`.

parameters.name: grain
parameters.description: The bucket size: `day` (the default) or `month`. Anything else returns 400 `invalid_grain`.

200.description: The usage history for the covered tenants.

400.description: `from` or `to` is missing or not `yyyy-MM-dd`, or `from` is later than `to` (`invalid_date_range`); `grain` is invalid (`invalid_grain`); or `tenant_ids` is invalid.

401.description: No bearer token, or an invalid or expired one.

403.description: The token is not allowed to read this: it is not a machine-client token (`machine_client_subject_required`), lacks the `pulse.read` scope (`missing_required_scope`), is outdated (`stale_token_version`), or belongs to a disabled tenant. A tenant outside the caller's scope in `tenant_ids` returns `tenant_out_of_scope`.

503.description: The usage history could not be provided (`pulse_usage_unavailable`), or the tenant scope could not be loaded. Retry later.

get.summary: Export vulnerability events for authorized partner tenants.
get.description:
This endpoint returns a single-page export of live vulnerability detection events, within a
bounded time window, for the authorized partner's tenant scope. The response is returned
with a `Content-Disposition: attachment` header naming a timestamped export file.

**Notes:**
- `tenant_ids` (optional, comma-separated) restricts the export to specific tenants.
- `from` / `to` (optional, ISO-8601 timestamps) bound the detection window; defaults to the
  last 24 hours. `from` must not be later than `to`.
- `source_type`, `severity`, `root_cause_type`, and `patchability` filter the result set.
- `format` (optional, default `json`) selects the export format; only `json` is currently
  supported; any other value returns 400.
- The export is capped at the maximum page size (500 events) and is not cursor-paginated.


Required headers:

- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` (requires the `pulse.read` scope)

parameters.name: tenant_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated tenant ids to read. Every id must be inside the caller's authorized scope, otherwise 403 `tenant_out_of_scope`. Omit it to read every authorized tenant.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the detection window, an ISO 8601 timestamp, treated as UTC. Defaults to 24 hours before `to`. Must not be later than `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the detection window, an ISO 8601 timestamp, treated as UTC. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The export format. Only `json` is supported; anything else returns 400 `unsupported_export_format`.

200.description: A page of detection events, sent as an attachment named `pulse-vulnerability-events-<timestamp>.json`.

400.description: `format` is not `json` (`unsupported_export_format`), the window is invalid, or `tenant_ids` is invalid.

401.description: No bearer token, or an invalid or expired one.

403.description: The token is not allowed to read this: it is not a machine-client token (`machine_client_subject_required`), lacks the `pulse.read` scope (`missing_required_scope`), is outdated (`stale_token_version`), or belongs to a disabled tenant. A tenant outside the caller's scope in `tenant_ids` returns `tenant_out_of_scope`.

503.description: The data store is unavailable (`pulse_vulnerability_event_export_unavailable`), or the tenant scope could not be loaded. Retry later.

get.summary: List the tenants in the authorized partner scope.
get.description:
Returns every tenant the calling machine client is authorized for, as a flat list
ordered by position in the hierarchy.

**Notes:**
- `parent_tenant_id` and `depth` describe each tenant's place in the hierarchy;
  the roots of the caller's scope have a `parent_tenant_id` outside it.

Required headers:

- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` (requires the `pulse.read` scope)

200.description: Every tenant the caller is authorized for.

401.description: No bearer token, or an invalid or expired one.

403.description: The token is not allowed to read this: it is not a machine-client token (`machine_client_subject_required`), lacks the `pulse.read` scope (`missing_required_scope`), is outdated (`stale_token_version`), or belongs to a disabled tenant. A tenant outside the caller's scope in `tenant_ids` returns `tenant_out_of_scope`.

503.description: The tenant scope could not be loaded (`tenant_scope_unavailable`). Retry later.

get.summary: Get one tenant and its sub-tenants from the authorized partner scope.
get.description:
Returns `tenantId` plus every tenant beneath it in the hierarchy, narrowed from the
caller's full authorized scope.

**Notes:**
- `tenantId` must be inside the caller's authorized scope; anything else returns 403,
  whether or not the tenant exists.

Required headers:

- `Authorization: Bearer {token}` (requires the `pulse.read` scope)

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant: a `tenant_id` from **List tenants**. It must be inside the caller's authorized scope.

legacy_instance_id.description:
The tenant's id in the previous CYRISMA API, where it was called `instance_id`, normally 32 hexadecimal
characters. Use it to match records kept from that API to `tenant_id`.
Every tenant has one, tenants created since included.

tenant_host.description: The tenant's host name, for example `cc2080fe.cyrisma.com`.

kind.description: Where the tenant sits in the hierarchy, for example `organization`, `customer` or `tenant`.

status.description: The tenant's state, for example `active`, `provisioning`, `suspended`, `disabled` or `deleted`.

parent_tenant_id.description: The tenant directly above this one. For the roots of the caller's scope this is a tenant outside the scope, or null.

depth.description: How many levels below the top of the hierarchy the tenant is. `0` is the top.

PartnerTenantRow.description: One tenant in the authorized scope.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the rows belong to.

rows.description: The tenant's rollup rows, highest `value_int` first, at most `limit`.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the series belongs to.

points.description: One point per day, oldest first.

root_tenant_id.description: The top of the caller's authorized scope.

grain.description: The bucket size the items are in: `day` or `month`.

from.description: First day of the range, as requested.

to.description: Last day of the range, as requested.

coverage.description: The tenants the history was read from.

items.description: One item per tenant and period. A tenant with no history in a period has no item for it.

PartnerUsageResponse.description: Endpoint usage history over a date range.

root_tenant_id.description: The top of the caller's authorized scope.

generated_at.description: When the export was produced, in UTC.

from.description: Start of the detection window, in UTC.

to.description: End of the detection window, in UTC.

coverage.description: The tenants the events were read from.

PartnerVulnerabilityEventExportResponse.description: A single page of live vulnerability detection events for download, capped at 500 events and not paginated. Sent with a `Content-Disposition: attachment` header.

root_tenant_id.description: The top of the caller's authorized scope: the tenant the access token was issued for.

from.description: Start of the detection window, in UTC. The default is 24 hours before `to`.

to.description: End of the detection window, in UTC. The default is the time of the request.

page_size.description: The number of rows this page was limited to: the `page_size` you asked for, or the default.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: send it back as `cursor`. Null on the last page.

coverage.description: The tenants this response was read from, after `tenant_ids` and `include_descendants` were applied. A tenant with no rows still appears here.

items.description: The detection events on this page. Empty when nothing was detected in the window.

PartnerVulnerabilityEventsResponse.description: One cursor-paginated page of live vulnerability detection events inside the requested window, newest first.

root_tenant_id.description: The top of the caller's authorized scope.

from.description: First day of the range, as requested.

to.description: Last day of the range, as requested.

group_by.description: The dimension the rows are grouped by: `cve`, `root_cause`, `severity` or `asset_type`.

limit.description: The most rows returned per tenant.

coverage.description: The tenants the rollups were read from.

tenants.description: The rollups, one entry per tenant read.

PartnerVulnerabilityRollupsResponse.description: Vulnerability rollups per tenant, grouped by one dimension over a date range.

root_tenant_id.description: The top of the caller's authorized scope.

range_days.description: The number of days of history returned: `30`, `60` or `90`.

coverage.description: The tenants the series were read from.

PartnerVulnerabilitySeriesResponse.description: A vulnerability trend per tenant: one point per day over the requested range.

root_tenant_id.description: The top of the caller's authorized scope.

open_finding_count.description: Findings that are currently open, across all severities.

affected_asset_count.description: Assets with at least one open finding.

affected_tenant_count.description: Tenants with at least one open finding.

kev_finding_count.description: Open findings for CVEs on a known-exploited-vulnerabilities list.

exploitable_finding_count.description: Open findings with published exploit evidence.

patchable_root_cause_count.description: Root causes with open findings that a patch can fix.

remediated_30d_count.description: Findings remediated in the last 30 days.

last_detection_at.description: When a finding was last detected, in UTC. Null when none has been.

source_tab_counts.description: The open findings split by how the asset is scanned.

lifecycle_series.description: Findings opened, remediated and still open, one point per day.

PartnerVulnerabilityStateResponse.description: A snapshot of vulnerability posture across the authorized tenants.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the kind of error.

title.description: A short summary of the error, or its code.

detail.description: More detail about this occurrence, when there is any.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies this occurrence, when there is one.

ProblemDetails.description: An error in the RFC 9457 problem format. The error code is in `title`, for example `tenant_out_of_scope` or `pulse_posture_unavailable`.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the usage belongs to.

period_start.description: The first day of the period: the day itself for `day`, the first of the month for `month`.

endpoint_count.description: The number of endpoints in the period.

email_count.description: The number of email addresses in the period.

TenantEndpointHistoryPoint.description: A tenant's usage in one period.

group_value.description: The value of the `group_by` dimension this row is for, for example a CVE id or a severity.

metric_group.description: The family the metric belongs to, for example `finding_lifecycle`.

severity.description: The severity the row is for. Empty when the row is not split by severity.

asset_type.description: The asset type the row is for. Empty when the row is not split by asset type.

value_int.description: The metric's value, summed over the days in the range.

value_float.description: The metric's fractional value, summed over the days in the range. Null when the metric has none.

sample_count.description: How many samples the value was built from.

reconciliation_state.description: Whether the row's figures agree with their source.

VulnerabilityRollupRow.description: One rollup row: a metric summed over the requested days for one value of the grouping dimension.

bearerAuth.description: A machine-client token from POST /v1/auth/client-token, carrying subject_type=machine_client and the pulse.read scope.
